title: Activision Blizzard Reports Q4 2025 Financial Results
content: Activision Blizzard today reported financial results for the quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025. Net revenues were $2.34 billion for the quarter. 'We are pleased with our strong performance in 2025,' said Bobby Kotick, President and CEO. 'Our world-class franchises continue to deliver exceptional entertainment to hundreds of millions of players around the world. We remain committed to delivering long-term value to our shareholders and look forward to continued growth in 2026.' The Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.47 per common share.
